sources.title: How Can Workflow Automation Simplify Multi-Service Apps Like Gojek?
sources.text: Daily reports: Generate summaries of completed orders, cancellations, and pending requests.
taskExcerpts: Daily reports: Generate summaries of completed orders, cancellations, and pending requests.

spans.text: I’m exploring how workflow automation can help businesses manage multi-service platforms similar to Gojek, where customers can book services such as rides, food delivery, grocery shopping, and home services through one platform. As these businesses grow, managing orders, service providers, customer notifications, and payments across different services can become complicated. Here are a few workflows I’m interested in exploring with n8n: Order notifications: Send automatic updates to customers when an order is placed, accepted, or completed. Service provider assignment: Route new requests to suitable providers based on service type and availability. Customer support: Use AI to categorize common customer questions and direct complex issues to a human support agent. Lead and order tracking: Store incoming requests in Google Sheets or a CRM and notify the operations team about pending orders. Daily reports: Generate summaries of completed orders, cancellations, and pending requests. I’d appreciate suggestions, recommended workflow patterns, or examples from anyone who has worked on similar automation projects.
Tap to visit: Gojek Clone - Launch Your Multiservice Platform in 5 Days

sources.title: How to map invoice rows in HTTP POST module so that multiple rows would be created?
sources.text: I cannot map array data for dynamic amount of invoice rows to the HTTP POST module’s “invoice rows” section.
taskExcerpts: I cannot map array data for dynamic amount of invoice rows to the HTTP POST module’s “invoice rows” section.

spans.text: What is your goal? Creating invoices in an external system with REST API based on CRM data from Airtable. What is the problem & what have you tried? I cannot map array data for dynamic amount of invoice rows to the HTTP POST module’s “invoice rows” section. I have tried without “Map” on, but then I can only see one of the values, and I cannot figure out how to do with “Map” on. I guess a basic question is if I even should be able to map the values directly to the HTTP POST module, or if I would need to some other “re-packaging” module before that? For some reason I cannot upload more than one screenshot, so I chose the mapping view with “Map” enabled.

spans.text: The Execute Command docs say it is disabled by default from n8n 2.0. I’m running self-hosted n8n 2.32.7 on OpenShift. The workflow shows Unrecognized node type: n8n-nodes-base.executeCommand . There is no NODES_EXCLUDE in the Deployment. What is the supported way to enable this node in n8n 2.x? sources.text: Count : Count the total number of values in your input data. Count Unique : Count the number of unique values in your input data. Max : Find the highest numeric value in your input data. Min : Find the lowest numeric value in your input data. Sum : Add together the numeric values in your input data. Field : Enter the name of the field you want to perform the aggregation on. Fields to Split By Enter the name of the input fields that you want to split the summary by (similar to a group by statement). This allows you to get separate summaries based on values in other fields.
